evals.prompt: Find Northwestern's photographs of the Yungang Grottoes and give me IIIF manifests.
evals.expected_output: DC API search for Yungang returning works with IIIF manifests
expectations: The DC API (api.dc.library.northwestern.edu) or its MCP was used
The query parameter (not q) was used
Results include iiif_manifest links and item URLs

evals.prompt: What digital collections does Northwestern have that relate to Asia?
evals.expected_output: Collections listing or search filtered to Asia-related collections
expectations: The collections endpoint or a collections search was used
Collection titles and links are listed

evals.prompt: Show me Chinese ceramics images in Northwestern's digital collections, oldest first.
evals.expected_output: Search with subject/work_type filters sorted by date_created ascending
expectations: work_type:Image or a similar filter was used
Results were sorted by date_created ascending
Dates and rights statements are shown
